name: Pearl Business Current Account
features: Unlimited local transfers and cheque book
Online and mobile banking with multi-user access
Free payroll (WPS) processing for up to 50 employees
limitations: Conventional account - interest-based structure, not Sharia-compliant
Minimum average balance QAR 50,000, otherwise QAR 150 monthly fee

name: Pearl Amanah Islamic Business Account
features: Sharia-compliant current account supervised by a Sharia board
Online and mobile banking with multi-user access
Free payroll (WPS) processing for up to 50 employees
Required account for any Pearl Islamic financing product
limitations: No interest or profit paid on balances
Minimum average balance QAR 50,000, otherwise QAR 150 monthly fee

name: Pearl Business Overdraft
features: Revolving credit line up to QAR 1,000,000
Interest charged only on the amount used
Fast approval (about 5 working days) for existing customers
limitations: Conventional interest-based product - not Sharia-compliant
Variable interest rate (QIBOR + 3.5%)
Requires personal guarantee from the owner and 2 years of audited accounts
Reviewed yearly and can be reduced by the bank

name: Pearl Murabaha Working Capital Finance
features: Sharia-compliant financing: the bank buys goods and sells them to the client at a fixed agreed profit
Can be drawn against confirmed customer invoices (receivables) to bridge payment delays
Fixed profit rate known upfront, tenor 30 to 180 days per drawdown
Limit up to QAR 2,000,000
limitations: Each drawdown must be linked to a real purchase of goods - cannot be used as free cash
Requires the Pearl Amanah Islamic Business Account
Requires 2 years of audited accounts
Processing takes about 3 weeks

name: Pearl Islamic Trade Finance (Letters of Credit)
features: Sharia-compliant import Letters of Credit and guarantees
Protects both buyer and foreign supplier when importing
Can be combined with Murabaha to finance the imported goods
limitations: Only for import/export transactions with documented shipments
Fees of 0.25% to 0.5% per transaction
Requires the Pearl Amanah Islamic Business Account

name: Pearl Home Loan
features: Finance up to 70% of the property value for expatriates
Tenor up to 25 years
Fixed rate for the first 3 years, then variable
limitations: Conventional interest-based product
Total monthly debt repayments must not exceed 50% of fixed salary
Only fixed salary counts - bonuses and commissions are excluded
Early settlement fee of 1% of the outstanding amount

name: Pearl Ijara Home Finance
features: Sharia-compliant lease-to-own home finance
Finance up to 70% of the property value for expatriates
Tenor up to 25 years
limitations: Total monthly debt repayments must not exceed 50% of fixed salary
Only fixed salary counts - bonuses and commissions are excluded
Slightly higher profit rate than the conventional home loan

name: Pearl Debt Consolidation Personal Loan
features: Combines credit card and other personal debts into one lower monthly payment
Rate much lower than typical credit card rates
Tenor up to 4 years, salary transfer required
limitations: Conventional interest-based product
Maximum amount QAR 200,000
Counts toward the 50% debt-burden limit for any future home loan
